entries.description: The MX Principles, the rules that govern how Machine Experience builds things, for humans and machines alike. Every principle, explained.

Machine Experience (MX) is the governance envelope above the discovery layer of the web. It defers to Schema.org, JSON-LD, microdata, and WCAG 2.1 AA, and adds the layer they leave open: provenance, lifecycle, locale, and the signed record an agent verifies before acting on a file.
Machine Experience matters because machines mediate an increasing share of commerce and decisions. Without MX, organizations become invisible to the machine layer deciding for millions.
